verdict.rationale: Natural-language-to-command generation is a fair question for a terminal emulator, since some terminals ship AI command assistance. Nothing in Alacritty's evidence pack documents any AI or natural-language command generation. Its documented features are vi mode, search, regex hints, multi-window, IPC and configuration, and the project describes itself as minimal and no-frills.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can type natural language and get the right shell command generated in place
